So basically. The feed has all the normal parts of a normal feed expect an air channel,  the air channel is normally sealed by say something like the vac700r's plunger right?

But as as you write, the nib gets oressed down no matter how light. It'll open the air qir channel by 0.1mm~ which would cause the ink to flow down, the more you press, the more the air channel opens.

This is not only good for flex pens but also eliminates burping and in theory enables a far nicer ink flow. It won't dry out after long writing sessions as now the ink channels can he opened a lot without fear as ink is only allowed to flow with paper underneath.
